# omni-spec

> 25 standards implemented from the specification text only (Unicode line breaking, graphemes and bidi; JSON; XML; HTML tokenizer; DEFLATE; Brotli; ZIP; PNG; GIF; JPEG; WebP; OpenType; WOFF2; Office Open XML; WebM; parts of Opus) in dependency-free Rust.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-spec && cd omni-spec && cargo test --offline --test json --test sha256` (expect: test result: ok).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: Apache-2.0 (code) + CC BY 4.0 (documents).
